description: This file defines a set of form fields and components for document editing in a React-based editor with Keystone.js integration. It includes input components like text, integer, URL, select, multiselect, checkbox, and complex child components, as well as utility functions to create and manage schema-based form fields.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Creates a form field object for text input, supporting input and textarea display modes.

methods.name: integer
methods.description: Creates a form field object for integer input with validation.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Creates a form field object for URL input with validation.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Creates a select dropdown form field with provided options and validation.

methods.name: multiselect
methods.description: Creates a multiselect dropdown form field with provided options and validation.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a placeholder form field that renders nothing.

methods.name: child
methods.description: Creates a child component field with options for block or inline types.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Creates a nested object schema with specified fields.

methods.name: conditional
methods.description: Defines a conditional schema based on a discriminant field.

methods.name: relationship
methods.description: Defines a relationship field referencing other lists.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Creates an array of schema components.

methods.name: component
methods.description: Defines a component with preview, schema, label, and optional toolbar.

methods.name: NotEditable
methods.description: A component that renders children in a non-editable span.
